Meet Emmanuel Adeosun

I’m Emmanuel Adeosun, an editor, proofreader, beta reader, and self-publishing support specialist dedicated to helping independent authors bring their stories to their full potential.

My work focuses on helping authors refine their manuscripts while preserving the originality, voice, and creative vision behind their stories.

From manuscript assessment and developmental feedback to line editing, copyediting, proofreading, book formatting, and Amazon KDP support, I provide practical help at different stages of the publishing journey.

I believe every manuscript deserves thoughtful attention. My approach combines careful reading, editorial judgment, constructive feedback, and a genuine understanding of what authors need to prepare their work for readers.

Six years of editorial and publishing support work.

Education: Master’s degree in English language (writing and speaking) from Crescent University. Currently studying for a PhD in English language.

    Privacy Policy

    1. Introduction

    Welcome to Emmanuel Editorial. Your privacy matters to us. This Privacy Policy explains how Emmanuel Adeosun, operating under the name Emmanuel Editorial, collects, uses, stores, and protects personal information when you visit this website, contact us, request our services, or submit a manuscript for editorial review. By using this website or engaging our services, you acknowledge that you have read this Privacy Policy.

    Terms of Service

    Emmanuel Editorial
    Last Updated: April 24, 2026

    1. Introduction

    Welcome to Emmanuel Editorial. These Terms of Service govern your use of this website and the editorial, proofreading, manuscript assessment, formatting, and self-publishing assistance services provided by Emmanuel Adeosun. By accessing this website, submitting an enquiry, requesting a quotation, or engaging our services, you agree to these Terms where applicable. Please read them carefully before proceeding with a project.

    2. About Emmanuel Editorial

    Emmanuel Editorial is a personal editorial service operated by Emmanuel Adeosun. Services include:

    • Developmental editing
    • Line editing
    • Copyediting
    • Proofreading
    • Beta reading
    • Manuscript assessment
    • Book formatting
    • Ebook and paperback preparation
    • Book cover design assistance
    • Amazon KDP publishing guidance
    • Self-publishing consultation

    Services are provided directly by Emmanuel Adeosun, subject to individual project agreements.

    3. Service Descriptions

    Each service has a specific purpose and scope.

    Developmental Editing

    Developmental editing examines the structure, organisation, pacing, characters, plot, worldbuilding, and overall storytelling of a manuscript. It provides editorial observations and recommendations to help strengthen the work.

    Line Editing

    Line editing focuses on sentence-level improvements, including clarity, flow, expression, readability, and writing style.

    Copyediting

    Copyediting addresses grammar, spelling, punctuation, language consistency, and other technical writing issues.

    Proofreading

    Proofreading is a final review intended to identify remaining typographical, grammatical, spelling, and punctuation errors. It is not a replacement for developmental editing or comprehensive rewriting.

    Beta Reading

    Beta reading provides an honest reader’s perspective on a manuscript, including observations about engagement, pacing, characters, clarity, and overall reading experience.

    Book Formatting

    Book formatting involves preparing the interior layout of a manuscript for digital or print publication, depending on the agreed specifications.

    Publishing Assistance

    Publishing assistance involves guidance and practical support in preparing books for self-publication, including Amazon KDP.

    The exact scope of each service will be agreed upon before work begins.

    4. Pricing and Quotations

    Our proposed pricing structure is:

    • Developmental Editing: $0.01 per word.
    • Line Editing: $0.01 per word.
    • Copyediting: $0.01 per word.
    • Proofreading: Custom quotation.
    • Beta Reading: Custom quotation.
    • Book Formatting: Starting from $100.
    • Book Cover Design: Starting from $200.
    • KDP Publishing Assistance: Custom quotation.

    Displayed prices are subject to confirmation based on the manuscript’s condition, word count, project complexity, deadlines, and agreed deliverables. A quotation provided for a project will specify the applicable price and scope. No additional charges should be applied without communicating them to the client and obtaining agreement.

    5. Project Confirmation and Payment

    Before work begins, both parties should agree on:

    • The service required.
    • Manuscript word count.
    • Project scope.
    • Total price.
    • Payment arrangements.
    • Expected delivery date.
    • Required deliverables.

    Work will commence after the agreed payment conditions have been satisfied. Payment arrangements, including deposits and instalments, will be communicated individually. Clients are responsible for ensuring that payment information is accurate and that agreed payments are completed.

    6. Manuscript Submission

    Clients are responsible for submitting the correct manuscript files and providing accurate project information. Submitted materials should:

    • Be accessible and readable.
    • Represent the intended manuscript version.
    • Include relevant instructions.
    • Be submitted in an agreed file format.

    Any substantial changes to the manuscript after work has commenced may affect the project scope, price, and delivery timeline.

    7. Revisions and Additional Work

    The revision arrangements for each project will be communicated before work begins. Requests that fall within the original agreed scope will be handled according to the project agreement. Requests involving substantial rewriting, additional chapters, new editing stages, or services outside the original agreement may require additional fees. Changes to the original manuscript after delivery may also require a separate quotation.

    8. Delivery and Deadlines

    Estimated delivery dates will be communicated during project confirmation. Delivery timelines depend on:

    • Manuscript length.
    • Type of service.
    • Manuscript condition.
    • Project complexity.
    • Agreed workload.
    • Timely communication and feedback.

    Clients are expected to provide requested materials and feedback promptly. If circumstances affect an agreed deadline, both parties should communicate and agree on an appropriate adjustment.

    9. Author Ownership and Intellectual Property

    Authors retain ownership of their original manuscripts and creative works. Emmanuel Editorial does not claim ownership of client manuscripts, original characters, stories, plots, concepts, or other intellectual property supplied for a project. The editorial services provided are intended to improve and prepare the author’s work while respecting their creative ownership. No client manuscript, cover, or project material will be publicly displayed as portfolio material without the author’s permission.

    10. Confidentiality

    We respect the privacy and confidentiality of our clients. Manuscripts and related project materials will be used only for the agreed services. We will not knowingly disclose, distribute, publish, or sell private client manuscripts without permission, except where disclosure is legally required. Clients may request a separate Non-Disclosure Agreement before submitting sensitive materials.

    11. Author Responsibilities and Final Approval

    The author remains responsible for reviewing and approving the final manuscript. Editorial recommendations are provided to assist the author in improving their work. The author has the final decision on whether to accept, reject, or modify suggested changes. Emmanuel Editorial does not guarantee that every reader, publisher, or reviewer will respond positively to an edited manuscript.

    12. Self-Publishing and Amazon KDP Disclaimer

    Emmanuel Editorial provides independent publishing assistance and guidance. We are not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Amazon or Kindle Direct Publishing. Authors retain ownership and control of their publishing accounts. We do not guarantee:

    • Acceptance of a book by Amazon KDP.
    • Specific publication dates.
    • Sales figures.
    • Bestseller rankings.
    • Reviews or ratings.
    • Royalties or commercial success.
    • Approval of advertising campaigns.

    Final publishing decisions are subject to the policies and processes of the relevant publishing platforms.

    13. Book Cover and Formatting Services

    Clients are responsible for providing accurate book specifications, including trim size, page count, printing requirements, and any other relevant production details. Where cover design or formatting is provided, the agreed deliverables and revision arrangements will be communicated before work begins. Final files should be reviewed by the author before submission to a publishing platform or printer. Printing and platform-specific requirements may change, and final approval remains subject to the relevant provider.

    14. Cancellations and Refunds

    If a client wishes to cancel a project, they should contact Emmanuel Editorial as soon as possible. Refund eligibility will depend on:

    • The agreed payment arrangement.
    • Whether work has commenced.
    • The amount of work already completed.
    • Any agreed cancellation conditions.

    Where work has already been completed, payment for completed work may not be refundable. Any refund or cancellation arrangement will be communicated transparently. Nothing in these Terms is intended to remove any consumer rights that cannot legally be excluded.
